summary: For conservation, Greece’s country-specific pledge is a 2030 LULUCF target of -1,154 Kt CO2eq against the 2016–2018 average, to be reported in 2032 and forming part of the EU-wide 310 Mt CO2 net-removals target. Under mixed restoration and conservation, ecologically sound reforestation and sustainable forest management offer 8–235 Mt CO2-eq/yr of mitigation potential; forest covers 38,810 km² (29.4%) of Greece, although no national allocation is given. For restoration, the EU target covers at least 20% of land and sea areas by 2030, with all ecosystems needing restoration by 2050, while peatland and wetland restoration offers 51–54 Mt CO2-eq/yr; Greece’s wetland class covers 175 km² (0.1%). In agriculture, improved fertiliser-use efficiency offers 19 Mt CO2-eq/yr, relevant to the 52,218 km² (39.5%) under agriculture, but this figure is EU-wide.
